Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players make their way back out to the middle. The two openers for Singapore, Surendran Chandramohan and Rohan Rangarajan are out in the middle and it will be Tendai Chatara to start off proceedings with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

If Singapore have to win this they will need to pull off a cracking run chase and will have to go from the very first delivery. Zimbabwe on the other will look to stick the basics and get over the line in a convincing manner. Stay tuned for the run chase as we still have ample entertainment in store for us.

Singapore bowlers were all over the place right from the start, unable to bowl good lines and length allowing Zimbabwe to score way too freely. After getting past the openers and Wesley Madhevere who fell cheaply, Singapore would have hoped to put some pressure and get a foot hold on the game. But what followed was absolute demolition of the Singapore bowling.

Zimbabwe started firing on all cylinders from the word go. After useful contributions from the openers it was Sikandar Raza and Sean Williams who added a 103 run partnership to get their team to a position of considerable strength. Sean Williams reached his half century and perished soon after but it was the exploits of Sikandar Raza that got Zimbabwe well past the 200 mark. He ended his innings on 87 runs facing just 39 deliveries in the penultimate over and looked devastating!

Singapore will be absolutely disappointed with their bowling performance after winning the Toss and electing to bowl first. They were unable to contain the Zimbabwe batters all through the innings and in the end are looking at a mammoth target to chase. Zimbabwe will be confident of their chances in this game having put 236 on the board especially given that Singapore have a relatively inexperienced line up.
Good delivery, in the blockhole around off. Milton Shumba bunts it back past the keeper and the batters pick up a couple of runs. Zimbabwe end with a mammoth total of 236/5!
Good running! This is shorter, Shumba advances and pulls it straight back past the bowler and races back for the second.
Around off, this is driven through mid off for a single.
Bye! Full and outside off, Shumba has a big swing at it but misses the ball. The batters though manage to scamper through for a bye.
FOUR! Cheeky from Milton Shumba and he picks up another boundary. This is at the stumps, Shumba moves across and gets it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
FOUR! Full and wide, this is thrashed away past point and for a boundary by Milton Shumba.
Ryan Burl is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Oh, no! Sikandar Raza holes out and his sensational innings comes to an end. Full and wide from Amjad Mahboob and gets it wide enough. Raza has to fetch it and throws his hands at it. Raza isn't in control of the shot and ends up flat-batting it to Surendran Chandramohan at the point fence and the fielder makes no mistake. The skipper gets a wicket and Raza has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Surendran Chandramohan b Amjad Mahboob

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is high-class batting from Sikandar Raza and he is now eyeing that 100! Full and on off stump, Raza just gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it past the man at short fine leg for a boundary.
On middle, this is drilled down to long on for one.
Swing and a miss! Milton Shumba walks right past the stumps and Amjad Mahboob follows him with a fuller one. Shumba swipes across but misses.
Full and at the toes, clipped away past square leg for just a single.

In the air but safe! This is banged in short and around leg stump, Milton Shumba tries to take it on but gets hurried. Shumba ends up getting a top edge that just eludes the man at short fine leg. The batters push hard for three and they do get it, excellent running.
SIX! Sikandar Raza takes full advantage of the free hit and gets in the big hit. Pitched up around off, this is lifted over the long off fence for a maximum. 26 off the over!

No ball and Four! Oh my, that is a poor, poor delivery from Janak Prakash! Tries to bowl it full and wide but serves a chest-high full toss outside off, Sikandar Raza somehow manages to reach it and ends up slicing it behind point for a boundary. Free Hit coming up!
Around off, Milton Shumba tries to free his arms and go over long off but doesn't get a good connection on it. Just a single then.
Prakash gets the yorker in at off stump and Raza can only manage to hit it towards long off for a single.
SIX! Nonchalant flick! A low full toss, sliding on the pads, Raza just picks it up and flat-bats it over the backward square leg fence for back-to-back maximums. The 200 is up for Zimbabwe!
SIX! Janak Prakash misses his length by a few inches and pays the price. Right in the slot on middle, Sikandar Raza just holds his shape and launches it back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Gets in the wide yorker, Milton Shumba manages to jam it out on the off side and get Sikandar Raza back on strike.
Janak Prakash is back into the attack.
Slower and shorter, around leg stump. Milton Shumba waits for it and pulls it down through square leg for a run.
Misfield and it allows the batters to come back for two. On off, Shumba gets across and works it towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder fumbles and they get an easy two.
Excellent comeback delivery from Amjad Mahboob. Nails the yorker on middle stump, Raza digs it out towards long on and picks up a single.

SIX! BANG! Amjad Mahboob drags this one halfway down the track and Sikandar Raza has all the time in the world to rock back and clobber this one way, way over the square leg fence for a monster hit. New ball, please!
Full again, on the pads, Shumba flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Much better from Mahboob! Full and straight, gets it in the blockhole, Raza can only manage to jam it out towards long on and pick up a single.
WIDE! Starts off with a poor delivery, way down the leg side and Raza leaves it alone.
Quicker and at the stumps, Raza pushes it through mid on for a single.
This is tossed up around off, Raza looks to go over covers but mistimes it badly.
On the pads, tucked away towards short fine leg.
Milton Shumba is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Really good catch in the deep and it's fifty and out for Sean Williams! Anantha Krishna puehes this one wider and Sean Williams has to fetch it again. Williams ends up slogging it with one hand off the handle of the bat and hits it aerially towards deep square leg. Arjun Mutreja over there takes a good running catch to his left and Singapore have the breakthrough they so desperately needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Arjun Mutreja b Anantha Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: This is fired in quicker and around off, Williams looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.

FOUR! What a comeback knock this has been from Sean Williams, brings the FIFTY for himself. This is pushed wide of the off stump, Williams fetches it and slogs it a couple of bounces into the wide long on fence.

FOUR! That is fifty for Sikandar Raza and he gets there in just 26 deliveries! Aryaman Sunil bowls this short again, angling down leg side and Sikandar Raza is waiting on the back foot to work this over short fine leg for another boundary! Sikandar Raza smiles as he raises his arms in celebaration. Very expensive over from Aryaman Sunil to end his spell as 16 runs have come off it.

FOUR! These short balls are not working against Sikandar Raza! Aryaman Sunil bangs this in short and a fraction outside off, Sikandar Raza goes across the stumps and pulls this hard towards the cow-corner fence for a one-bounce boundary! Sikandar Raza is just one hit away from a well-deserved half-century!
Aryaman Sunil goes outside off on a good length. Sean Williams works this through cover-point for a single.
Aryaman Sunil goes full and outside off, Sikandar Raza works this through covers to get off strike.

FOUR! Sikandar Raza gets into his 40's in quick time! Aryaman Sunil bangs this one in short and angling down leg. Sikandar Raza is seeing the ball well now and does not miss out on this as he pulls it to the left of short fine leg for a boundary towards the deep backward square leg fence!
Aryaman Sunil serves this full outside off, Sikandar Raza powers this wide of long off and gets a brace.
Flatter delivery, around off, Raza just guides it towards the man at short third man and sets off for a quick single.
Around off, Sean Williams fetches it and sweeps it hard and low towards deep backward square leg for one.
This time they settle for the single. Krishna sees Raza advancing and shortens the length. Raza works it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Good running again. On middle, this is pushed through mid on and the batters race back for two. The 150 is up for Zimbabwe.
Firmly hit but straight to the man. Tossed up around off, Raza thrashes this one towards the man at extra cover.
Slower through the air and on a length, Raza just nudges it away towards the vacant mid-wicket region. The bowler chases it down but cannot prevent the second run.
Aryaman Sunil delivers this full on the pads, Sean Williams flicks this in the gap at deep square leg and completes a couple of runs. Aryaman Sunil keeps it tight and concedes just 7 runs once again.
Straying into the pads from a good length. Sikandar Raza guides this through square leg and takes a run.
Delivered on a good length and wide outside off, Sean Williams goes back in the crease and thumps it to deep cover for a single.
Goes a fraction full this time and outside off, Sikandar Raza tries to work this leg side and gets hit on the pads. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls towards the gully region.
On a good length and angling away from middle, Sean Williams knocks this slightly in the air towards point and takes a quick single.
Aryaman Sunil Begins with a short delivery in line with the stumps, Sean Williams pulls this wide of deep square leg for a brace.
Aryaman Sunil (2-0-20-1) is back on.
Quicker delivery, there's width on offer too but this time Sean Williams slaps it straight to the man at deep cover for just a single.
On middle this time, this is slogged away towards cow corner for a brace.
FOUR! Quicker and shorter, around off. Williams has enough time to rock back and free his arms. Williams muscles it well in front of the fielder at deep mid-wicket to collect yet another boundary.
FOUR! Gets it through! Around the off pole, Sean Williams plays the reverse sweep and the man at short third man gets an awkward bounce as the ball goes through him and into the fence.
Drifting onto the pads, Raza tickles it down towards short fine leg for one more.
Quicker delivery, on off. Williams punches it down to long on for a single.
At the stumps, Sean Williams plays the reverse sweep and gets it down towards short third man for a quick single.
On a shorter length and on off stump, Williams fails to pull it away and manages to hit it back towards the bowler.
Full once again and in line with the middle stump. Sean Williams gets forward and pushes this to the mid on fielder.
This is a fraction short and in line with the stumps. Sean Williams makes room and hits it hard to the cover fielder.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries and while the first one was powered this one is all about placement. Anantha Krishna fires this full outside off, Sean Williams reverse sweeps this to the left of the short third man fielder to get the second boundary of the over.

FOUR! Lovely use of the feet here! Anantha Krishna floats this one full outside off, Sean Williams is down the wicket in a jiffy and lofts it straight back over the bowler for a boundary. The long on fielder is present but the shot is straight enough to beat him.
Flatter and around off, this is pushed out towards the man at short extra cover. At the halfway mark, Zimbabwe are flying at 116/3!
Smart batting this, rotating the strike after the boundary. Angling into leg stump, Williams works it past mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Puri continues to come from around the wicket and angles this one into middle and leg. Sean Williams gets low and brings out the slog-sweep, flat-batting it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Good running! A tad shorter and outside off, Sean Williams rocks back and cuts it in front of square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Flatter delivery, angled across the off stump, Raza backs away and cuts it to deep point for just one.
Sliding onto the pads, this is swept away towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Over the wicket to the right-hander once again. Sikandar Raza just knocks it through the vacant cover region for a single to keep strike.
Floats this full outside off to Sean Williams who works this towards covers for a single.

Full and angling into the pads from outside off, Sikandar Raza gets forward and tries to work this leg side. Gets hit on the pad and the ball rolls to the off side. Huge appeal from the bowler as the batters get across for a leg bye.

SIX! This one has been pounded! Anantha Krishna serves this really short and outside off, Sikandar Raza gets across the stumps and thumps it over the deep squareleg boundary for a biggie! Sikandar Raza has come out with all guns blazing!
This one is full outside off as well, Sean Williams works this towards point for single.

Anantha Krishna goes 'round the wicket and floats this one full outside off, Sean Williams pulls out the reverse sweep and some poor fielding from short third man allows the batters to complete two runs.
Poor fielding this from Singapore and they concede the extra run. On middle, just pushed down to long on for one. The throw is wide and this allows the batters to come back for the second.

EDGED AND FOUR! Make that a hat-trick of boundaries, albeit a lucky one this time around. Flatter delivery around off, Raza looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper and into the vacant third man fence.
FOUR! Two in a row! Puri switches to 'round the wicket and tries to angle it across the right-hander, Sikandar Raza plays the reverse sweep and dispatches it into the backward point fence.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! Outside off, Raza drives it firmly and beats sweeper cover for a boundary.
This is quicker and on middle, Sikandar Raza just gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine past the man at short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Floats it up first up around off, Sean Williams just caresses it through extra covers for a single.
Akshay Roopak Puri is into the attack now.

Good over from Aryaman Sunil. This one is angled away from outside off on a good length. Sean Williams plays it late and works it past backward point for another run to retain strike. Just 7 runs of the over and Singapore will be happy with this!
Aryaman Sunil serves this on a length and outside off, Sikandar Raza guides it to deep backward point fro another single.
Full once again and angling away from the left-hander, Sean Williams plays it with soft hands towards mid off and takes a quick single.
This one is full and outside off, Sikandar Raza taps it towards point and goes across for a run.

Aryaman Sunil pulls his length back slightly and angles it into the stumps, Sikandar Raza tucks this off his hips towards backward square leg and some good running between the wickets as they complete a brace.
Aryaman Sunil serves this wide outside off from a good length. Sean Williams works this to deep cover-point for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft, soft dismissal for Wesley Madhevere and he will be disappointed with that shot. This is on a fuller length from Janak Prakash and is a bit slower too. Madhevere goes for the expansive cover drive but is way too early in his shot. Madhevere ends up just stroking it into the hands of the man at cover. Akshay Roopak Puri takes a simple catch and Zimbabwe end the Powerplay being 3 down for 70. Singapore slowly but surely making a comeback in the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Akshay Roopak Puri b Janak Prakash

Commentary.Commentary: Sikandar Raza is the new man in.
WIDE! Yet another extra and this is poor bowling from Singapore. Fuller and sliding down the leg side, Madhevere swings at it but misses and a wide is called.
Drifted on the pads, Sean Williams tucks it away 'round the corner and rotates the strike.
Good running again! Fuller and at the stumps, Madhevere pushes it firmly towards mid on and picks up a single.
WIDE! Short of a good length and angling just down the leg side, wide signaled.
Excellent running! On a good length over off stump, this is just bunted around the silly point region and the batters set off for the single.

A bit of yes and no and it almost brings another wicket for Singapore. Length again and around off, Williams nudges it towards extra cover and Madhevere looks for the single but is sent back. The fielder gets in the direct hit but the dive has saved Madhevere.
A length ball, around the top of off, Williams pushes it out onto the off side.
Sean Williams is in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brave bowling this from Aryaman Sunil and he has got the big fish! After being pulled away for a boundary, Sunil digs in yet another short ball and gets it around head height. Craig Ervine looks to take it on but gets hurried on and the ball goes high of the top edge and behind the stumps. Manpreet Singh the keeper settles under it and takes a goodn catch. Ervine departs after a fiery start and Singapore have their second.
Commentary.Howout: c Manpreet Singh b Aryaman Sunil

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Craig Ervine is looking dangerous here! This one is served short and in line with the stumps. Does not get high enough and sits up nicely for Craig Ervine to pull this hard over the mid-wicket fielder for another boundary! What a powerplay this has been for Zimbabwe!
Angled into the stumps from outside off and on a good length. Wesley Madhevere guides this towards mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Serves this one full and outside off, Craig Ervine works this through covers for a single.

SIX! That is how you utilize a Free Hit! To be fair though not the best of deliveries from Aryaman Sunil as he bowls a slower delivery right in the slot and in line with the stumps. Craig Ervine removes his front foot out of the way and powers this over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum! Zimbabwe are going really strong here led by their skipper!
NO BALL! Aryaman Sunil commits a massive error as he oversteps and gives Zimbabwe a Free Hit! This one is also short and wide from off, Craig Ervine slashes at it and misses.
Aryaman Sunil begins with a short delivery wide outside off, Craig Ervine misses out as he hits it straight to the point fielder.
Aryaman Sunil to have a bowl now.
A touch fuller and around off, Madhevere strokes it away towards extra cover.
WIDE! Prakash tries to attack the body of the batter but spills it down the leg side, wide called.
Back of a length, outside off, Madhevere plays it off the back foot but straight towards backward point.
Wesley Madhevere is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and Janak Prakash hits the bullseye much to Singapore's relief. On a length and angling into middle and leg, Chakabva tucks it away towards short mid-wicket and is off for a single. Craig Ervine isn't interested and the bowler is quick to reach the ball. Chakabva turns and looks to get back but it is a super throw from the bowler and the bails are whipped off as Chakabva is run out by a mile. A much-needed breakthrough then for Singapore.
Good stop in the end. On the pads, this is flicked away towards short fine leg where the fielder gets a hand to it. The batters race back for two and the 50 is up for Zimbabwe in super quick time.
FOUR! Controlled aggression from Zimbabwe and they are enjoying batting first. Goes full and on off, Chakabva thumps it back over the bowler's head for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Good-length ball, around off, Chakabva with a powerful back-foot punch through covers and he finds the fence. Top shot this!
WIDE! Tries to bowl it wider this time but spills it beyond the tramline. Another wide.
WIDE! Starts off with a length ball angling down leg, Chakabva misses the flick and a wide is called.
Janak Prakash is into the attack now.
Finally gets it right as he pitches this on middle from a good length. Regis Chakabva works this towards backward square leg and some good fielding this time restricts the batters to just a single.
WIDE! Amjad Mahboob is not getting his radar right here. This one is straying down leg side from a good length. Regis Chakabva is happy to leave this one alone and take the extra run.
WIDE! Amjad Mahboob bangs this short into the wicket and angles it down leg side. Regis Chakabva leaves this alone and the umpire calls a wide.

Amjad Mahboob delivers this on a good length in line with the stumps. Regis Chakabva uses his wrists and works it through square leg. Some ordinary fielding allows the batters to complete a couple of runs.
Full and just outside off, Regis Chakabva knocks this back to the bowler.
This one is served full and on the legs, Craig Ervine flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.
Full once again but this time outside off, Regis Chakabva plays it with soft hands towards cover and rushes across for a single.
FOUR! This is some loose bowling from Singapore! Amjad Mahboob strays into the pads on a full length. Regis Chakabva flicks this towards backward square leg for a boundary!
FOUR! 19 off the over and Ervine is on fire! This is quicker and flatter around off, Ervine gets inside the line of the ball and sweeps it hard into the backward square leg fence.
FOUR! Blistering start this from Craig Ervine and Zimbabwe! Fuller and on the pads, Ervine gets down on one knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! Easily done! Tossed-up delivery, around off. Craig Ervine dances down the track and just lifts it over the long off fence for a maximum.
This is flatter and sliding down leg, Ervine gets low and looks to paddle it fine but misses.
FOUR! Hammered away! Goes fuller and on middle, Craig Ervine gets down on one knee and slogs it away through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Starts off with a length ball at the stumps, Chakabva pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Vinoth Baskaran to bowl from the opposite end.
Much better from Amjad Mahboob as he tucks the batter in from a good length. Craig Ervine fends this towards leg side.
Amjad Mahboob adjusts his length and goes slightly full and closer to off stump. Craig Ervine knocks this towards cover.

FOUR! Craig Ervine joins the party now! Amjad Mahboob serves this short and wide from off stump and Craig Ervine slashes it hard through point for his first boundary! Both Zimbabwe batters are on their way now!
This one is angled in from outside off on a good length. Craig Ervine works this towards mid-wicket.
Amjad Mahboob delivers this full and outside off. Regis Chakabva plays this to the right of covers for a single.
FOUR! Zimbabwe off the mark straight away! The skipper begins with a short delivery wide outside off.  Regis Chakabva does not need an invitation to thump this through covers for his first boundary!

We are ready for play! The umpires and the players of Singapore make their way out to the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine are the openers for Zimbabwe. Amjad Mahboob has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Craig Ervine, the captain of Zimbabwe says that there will be a bit in the wicket early on but it will ease out. Adds that they spent some time here and the training was good and the guys are raring to go. Informs that Sean Williams, Blessing Muzarabani and a few others are back in the fold.

The skipper of Singapore, Amjad Mahboob says the wicket looks very good and they will try to take advantage of the over ahead conditions and restrict Zimbawe to low score. Says that they did well against PNG even though they are a good side and have ODI status. Informs that Surendran Chandramohan is their main batter and hopes that he brings his form here and does the best for Singapore.
UPDATE 12.37 pm IST (7.07 am GMT) - There is a slight delay and the match that was scheduled to begin at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT) will now begin at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT).

Singapore (Playing XI) - Surendran Chandramohan, Rohan Rangarajan, Aman Desai, Manpreet Singh (WK), Arjun Mutreja, Janak Prakash, Aryaman Sunil, Vinoth Baskaran, Amjad Mahboob (C), Anantha Krishna and Akshay Roopak Puri.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Milton Shumba, Wellington Masakadza, Luke Jongwe, Tendai Chatara and Blessing Muzarabani.
TOSS - Singapore have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Singapore are one of the rising teams in world cricket, especially in the shortest format and they do have some powerful hitters in their ranks. The loss of star man Tim David, who is looking to switch allegiances and play for Australia will certainly have an impact but Janak Prakash will hope to fill that void and provide stability to that middle order. An encounter that has a lot riding on it and we can expect some fireworks for sure. Which side will start the campaign with a win? We'll find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.
